book.name: Lɛme
book.title: Ŋwa wu Lɛme chi booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso

content: Fiɛɛ njɛ kifilɛ to fɛ Konɛyu le
Muh mu gɛ̀ bee a kilaantɛŋ ki Kasalia le ba tɛŋe wu lɛ Konɛyu, nyu kikwɛɛ ki ŋgoo yimi yi bamii ba nchi ba Lum, yì ba gɛ̀ tɛŋe lɛ yi Itali.
Wu gɛ̀ bee muh wù bamii bachii ba a wu yeh gɛ̀ bee bo leesɛ muntele yi Nyo le chuule. Wu ŋgvuune, wu buune Nyo segechii, wu nyaa nnya ye chuule. Bajuu ba gɛ̀ fuude le.
Gɛ̀ bee juu chimi njɛ juu bikaa bitɛde fɛnshɛ, fiɛɛ, njɛ kifilɛ ja fi to fɛ wu le, wu jagɛ wu yɛŋ nchɛndaa wu Nyo le chuule a fiɛɛ fiyu le. Nchɛndaa wɛɛ gɛ̀ to wu lee wu tɛɛŋ wu lɛ, “Konɛyu.”
Konɛyu faaŋ, wu noŋ ajii ye ye le wu biih wu le lɛ, “Chiji kikwɛɛ, le la?” Nchɛndaa wɛɛ chvuu lɛ, “Nyo le wu yu wa buunɛ chuŋ, wu ka wu yɛŋ nnya yi wo nyaa bamii ba fuude le, wu kwajɛ wo.
Yi mɛɛse le, tuŋ bamii Joba bo gɛɛŋ bo tɛɛŋ muh mu wù jee che le Samoŋ, chimi lɛ Bita.
Wu chee bɛ Samoŋ wu kɛɛnyi jé wu la che le mbebe joo yì baaŋ le.”
No nchɛndaa wu Nyo wɛɛ jɛme noo wu mo wu ja. Konɛyu shɛɛ wu tɛɛŋ bamii be ba lɛme bafɛɛ, wu tɛɛŋ tɛ muh nchi wumu wù gɛ̀ chiɛɛne wu, gɛ̀ bee muh wù gɛ̀ leesɛ tɛ fitele yi Nyo le.
Lɛ bo to, wu sɛɛŋ fiɛɛ fichii fì be kooshɛ bɛ wu bo le, wu mo wu tuŋ bo Joba.
Nyo dunyɛ kiŋgha ki fiɛɛ Bita le
Akfuuŋ bu ayuu, gɛ̀ bee njɛ fɛnshɛ antɛnɛɛ, bo fɛɛse wa a kilaantɛŋ kiyu le. Bita ja wu bɛɛŋ a yeh we ki wu bûunɛ.
Jɛŋ kɛ yi yuu wu, wu mo wu goone ki wu jî mwɛɛ, ba baaŋ ba dɛɛde lo mwɛɛ munjile. Fiɛɛ njɛ kifilɛ ja fi to fɛ wu le.
Wu yɛŋ a fiɛɛ fiyu le, kibvulɛ gwenyɛ, fiɛɛ fimi shiide fɛwe njɛ kikwɛɛ ki nju, ba jiji yi abu le ana.
Chikfuu chi nyáŋ yichii, yì jiɛnyi nshɛŋ le, bɛ yì loone, mo munyii mù fuune we, nyu yi nju yiyu le.
Jɛ ja yi jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Bita, ja we wo yuuyɛ wo ji.”

content: Bita chvuu lɛ, “Tada, gɛ taŋlo mɛ moŋ gɛ, nje ŋgɛ mbaaŋ aji gɛ wa fiɛɛ fì nchɛ kɛnɛ fiɛɛ fì le njɛ fi yuude gɛ sɛŋ.”
Jɛ yiyu ka yi jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Keefɛ wo nyîɛŋse fiɛɛ fì Nyo le wu fɛ wa fi yuude gɛ.”

content: Fi kooshɛ noo bu kiŋgane kintɛde, bo mo bo kaasɛ bo bɛɛŋsɛ fiɛɛ fiyu we.

Fiɛɛ fiyu fì gɛ̀ to njɛ kifilɛ fi fuuŋsɛ Bita wu tu wu maŋe laa fi duunyi nyu la lɛ. Gɛh segeyu bamii ba Konɛyu gɛ̀ tuŋ baa to wa bo biide fɛ la chi Samoŋ wù gɛ̀ kɛɛnyi jé le fo, bo tu bo lɛme jwe wu kitaŋ le,
bo tɛŋe, bo biide lɛ, “Muh wu jiɛnyɛ wumu le fɛnɛ jee che nyu lɛ Samoŋ Bita?”
No Bita gɛ̀ baaŋ wu kwaji kune fiɛɛ fiyu fì gɛ̀ to fɛ wu le, Kiyo ki Yuude ja ki jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Bîjɛ yɛ̂ŋ, bamii batɛde goone wo.
Ja we wo boh bena bo gɛɛne kikaa kimimia. Keefɛ wo chîide lo ye gɛ, tuŋ mɛ bo.”
Noo, Bita mo wu ja wu boh, wu jɛmɛ bamii bayu le lɛ, “Le mɛ wù bɛŋ goone. Bɛŋ to lɛ la?”

Bo chvuu lɛ, “Konɛyu wu le kikwɛɛ ki ŋgoo yimi yi bamii ba nchi ba Lum le wu tuŋ bee. Wu le muh wù chaaŋ, wu faane Nyo, Bajuu bachii ŋgvuune wu. Nchɛndaa wu Nyo wù yuude wumu chi wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ wu chiiŋsɛ ntuŋ lɛ wo to a wu yeh, wu yu fiɛɛ fì wo lé wo jɛ̂me wu le.”
No bo chvuse noo, Bita mo wu jɛmɛ bo lee bɛ bo che. Bita gɛɛŋ ntuŋ wu Nyo a Konɛyu ye Akfuuŋ bu ayuu, wu ja bɛ bo mo bo gɛɛne. Bamii ba mbɛmɛ bamu ba Joba bi wu le.
Bo jiɛnyɛ bo che, bvu bu bvu yuu bo fɛsɛ Kasalia. Konɛyu bɛ bamii be ba kfuu mo nsáa ye yi shɛ́ŋ yi wu gɛ̀ tɛŋɛ gɛ̀ bee bo chiɛɛne wa bo.
No Bita gɛ̀ lese wu gɛɛne yeh, bɛ Konɛyu tasɛ. Konɛyu gwe a wu jii wu ŋgvuuŋ wu.
Geenɛ, Bita chiaasɛ wu we wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Ja we, nle gɛh tɛ fiaŋ muh wu wuŋ njɛ wo.”
Wu tu wu jɛme bɛ Konɛyu bo lese bo gɛɛne yeh, bo doo bo lee, bo yɛŋ bamii so lo yu.

Wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ, “Bɛŋ kee chuule lɛ nchi wese baaŋ bɛɛŋ gɛ lɛ muh wu Bajuu lade jigɛ wu ka taashi nsaŋ bɛ muh wu le gɛ muh wu Bajuu gɛ. Geenɛ, Nyo le wu dunyɛ mɛne lɛ gɛ ŋkɛme ki ntɛŋe muh mu nduu lɛ wu le muh wù nchɛ kɛnɛ lɛ gɛ wu yuude gɛ.
Noo, bɛŋ chi doo bɛŋ chiiŋsɛ ntuŋ lɛ nto, mɛ mo nto, mbaaŋ tɛɛnyɛ gɛ. Mɛ mo mbiide bɛŋ le laa bɛŋ tɛŋe mɛ lɛ la lɛ?”
Konɛyu chvuu lɛ, “Abɛŋ le wa aju ana no nchi mbee a mɛ yeh njɛ kife ki mɛɛse le juu bikaa bitɛde fɛnshɛ mbuune. Muh mu jagɛ wu bu a mɛ fwe wù nyu wu noŋ njú yi lale ye le.
Wu jɛmɛ mɛne lɛ, ‘Konɛyu, Nyo le wu yu wa buunɛ chuŋ wu ka wu yɛŋ nnya yi wo nyaa bamii ba fuude le, wu kwajɛ wo.
Noo, tuŋ bamii Joba bo gɛɛŋ bo tɛɛŋ muh mu wù jee che le Samoŋ, chimi lɛ Bita. Wu chee bɛ Samoŋ wù kɛɛnyi jé wù la che le mbebe joo yì baaŋ le.’
Kimimia noo, nchi mo nchiiŋsɛ ntuŋ lɛ wo to. Wo to nɛ, fi joŋ baaŋ. Bee mo be nyume fɛnɛ a Nyo jii ki bee yu fiɛɛ fì Tada tuŋ wo lɛ wo to wo jɛmɛ bee le.”
Bita jɛmɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ bee gɛ Bajuu le gɛ kune Jiso Kletu
Bita mo wu kɛ wu tu wu jɛme wu duu lɛ, “Yi nchiɛɛŋ le, nle n'yɛŋ lɛ gɛh Nyo duunyi yeye yeye gɛ.
Muh wuchii wù faane wu, wu ka gee fiɛɛ fì chuule le, wu fii wu wu jiiŋe gɛ laa mwɛdɛ bu faane la.
Bɛŋ kee ntuŋ wu Nyo gɛ̀ chiiŋsɛ fɛ bamii ba Ishwala le, wu feeji saaka wù joŋe lɛ Jiso Kletu gɛ̀ to wu lɛ nyiɛgee taŋlo wù nyu antɛnɛɛ a Nyo bɛ bamii. Jiso Kletu wunɛ le Kikwɛɛ ki bamii bachii.
Bɛŋ kee fiɛɛ fì gɛ̀ kooshɛ woŋ wu Judia le wuchii, fi gɛ̀ kɛ Galalee ajiŋ a kife kì Joŋ gɛ̀ feeji wu leese bamii a joo.

Bɛŋ kee tɛ no Nyo gɛ̀ chvu lo Kiyo ki Yuude yi Jiso wu Nasalɛ le, wu ka wu nya bvuŋga wu le, wu tu wu nyume bɛ wu. No Nyo gɛ̀ bee bɛ wu, wu tu wu jiɛnyi manjuu le manchii wù gee lɛme chì joŋe wu ka fɛde bamii ba debele nyuse.
Le bee ba gɛ̀ yɛŋ mwɛɛ mù wu gɛ̀ gee woŋ wu Bajuu le wuchii, bɛ mù wu gɛ̀ gee a kilaantɛŋ ki Yɛlusalɛm le. Ba gɛ̀ ta wu yi kintaaŋ le wu kwe.
Geenɛ, lɛ doo nyu aju atade, Nyo bvusɛ wu yi kwe le, wu ge bamii yɛŋ wu le.
Gɛ nyu bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ yɛŋ wu le gɛ. Gɛ̀ yɛŋ gɛh bee ba Nyo gɛ̀ cha lɛ bee feeji kune Jiso. Bee gɛ̀ jii mwɛɛ bee ka muu besa ba Jiso sege wu gɛ̀ bu yi kwe le.
Wu jɛmɛ lɛ bee lé be gê be fêeji jɛ yi Nyo bamii le, bee ka sɛŋe bo le lɛ le wu wù Nyo le wu baa lɛ le wu wù ge wu sa bamii ba baaŋ yu mo ba kweeyɛ wa.
Jiso wunɛ le wu wù bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo bachii gɛ̀ jɛme kune wu lɛ le yɛɛŋ wu lé wu gɛ̂ɛ fitele fie yi ye ye le, Nyo le wu lɛɛshɛ bimbefɛ bie fede yi jee che le.”
Kiyo ki Yuude to yi bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu le gɛ
Gɛh no Bita gɛ̀ baaŋ wu jɛme mwɛɛ munɛ, Kiyo ki Yuude ja ki shii, ki to yi muh le wuchii wù gɛ yuge njɛmɛ wɛɛ le.
De yuŋ bamii ba mbɛmɛ ba le Bajuu ba gɛ̀ bi Bita le, no bo gɛ̀ yɛŋ Nyo nya tɛ nnya ye yì le Kiyo ki Yuude bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ.
Bajuu baa tu bo yuge no bo jɛme jɛ́ yì bo kee gɛ, bo yuuse Nyo. Bita mo wu biih lɛ,
“No Kiyo ki Yuude le ki to wa yi bamii banɛ le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no ki gɛ̀ to yi ye yese besabɛŋ le, taŋlo muh ka wu faŋ lɛ keefɛ ba lêesɛ bo a joo gɛ?”
No Bita bile noo, wu mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ ba leesɛ bo a joo a jee chi Jiso Kletu le. Ajiŋ ayu le, bamii bayu lɛgɛ lɛ wu che bɛ bo yi aju le shige fɛ wu ja.
